scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.test:advanced: npm run test:advanced --workspace backend && npm run test:advanced --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend
scripts.analyze:trace:help: echo 'Usage: npm run analyze:trace -- <trace-file-path>' && echo 'Example: npm run analyze:trace -- ./trace-artifacts/trace.json' && echo 'Outputs: trace-summary.json in the same directory as trace file'
scripts.generate-tests:help: echo 'Usage: npm run generate-tests -- <spec-file-path>' && echo 'Example: npm run generate-tests -- tests/specs/user-registration.yml' && echo 'Outputs: UT, E2E, and Mock files'
scripts.generate:quality-items:help: echo 'Usage: npm run generate:quality-items -- [mode] [outputDir]' && echo 'Modes: simple (default), detailed' && echo 'Example: npm run generate:quality-items -- detailed qa/quality-characteristics/generated'
scripts.generate:dashboard:help: echo 'Usage: npm run generate:dashboard -- [kpiDataDir] [outputDir] [title]' && echo 'Example: npm run generate:dashboard -- qa/dashboard-data docs/dashboard Quality-Dashboard'
scripts.generate:e2e-report:help: echo 'Usage: npm run generate:e2e-report -- [outputDir]' && echo 'Example: npm run generate:e2e-report -- qa/e2e-report' && echo 'Outputs: test-cases.json with detailed test results'
scripts.generate:e2e-details:help: echo 'Usage: npm run generate:e2e-details -- [reportDataPath] [outputDir]' && echo 'Example: npm run generate:e2e-details -- qa/e2e-report/test-cases.json docs/reports' && echo 'Outputs: e2e-latest.html interactive details page'
